description: This file is a public header defining the API and data structures for Ethernet Bridge functionality in the Zephyr networking stack. It includes structure definitions, function prototypes for managing Ethernet bridges and interfaces, and macros for initialization.

methods.name: eth_bridge_iface_add
methods.description: Adds a network interface to an Ethernet bridge, enabling it to participate in bridging traffic.

methods.name: eth_bridge_iface_remove
methods.description: Removes a network interface from an Ethernet bridge.

methods.name: eth_bridge_iface_allow_tx
methods.description: Enables or disables transmission mode on a bridged interface.

methods.name: eth_bridge_listener_add
methods.description: Registers a listener to receive packets sent to the bridge.

methods.name: eth_bridge_listener_remove
methods.description: Unregisters a listener from the bridge.

methods.name: eth_bridge_get_index
methods.description: Returns the index of a given bridge instance.

methods.name: eth_bridge_get_by_index
methods.description: Retrieves a bridge instance by its index.

methods.name: net_eth_bridge_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all active bridge instances, calling a callback for each.
